delivery.question: How many days does it take to deliver the project?
delivery.answer: Depending on the scope, e-commerce projects are usually completed between 4-10 weeks.

pricing.question: How is pricing determined?
pricing.answer: It is determined based on the project scope and integration needs.

revisions.question: Do I have the right to revisions?
revisions.answer: We make the necessary revisions together during the design phase.

maintenance.question: Do you provide post-launch support?
maintenance.answer: Yes. We offer technical support and maintenance services after launch.

migration.question: Can you migrate my existing e-commerce site?
migration.answer: Yes. We securely migrate your product, customer, and order data to the new platform.

mobile.question: Do you also develop mobile apps?
mobile.answer: Yes. Optionally, we develop mobile applications integrated with your e-commerce site.
